lead.zh: 将原理词条与论文卡交替阅读。每篇都记录研究问题、证据设置和适用边界；未披露的部分保留为未知。
lead.en: Alternate concepts and paper cards. Record each research question, evidence setup and scope; leave undisclosed details unknown.

steps: 论文卡-Attention Is All You Need

zh: 把一份技术报告的训练章节拆成预训练/后训练两段，各说出关键变量
看到「刷新 SOTA」的说法，先查评测集发布时间和训练截止日期的关系
读模型卡时能指出许可证、评测口径和已知局限三处关键信息
对路线里的论文卡，各说出研究问题与核心证据位置，并说出至少一条「论文没有主张」的流行说法
读论文时，摘要、实验设置、局限性分别该抓什么？
困惑度低是否等于生成质量高？
知识蒸馏与量化的目标有何不同？
论文卡里的「证据位置」为什么比结论更重要？
开放权重与开源模型的差别，为什么要看许可证？
看到「模型卡」时，如何判断评测是否可复现？
en: Split a tech report's training section into pretraining and post-training, naming the key variables of each
On seeing a "new SOTA" claim, first check the benchmark's release date against the model's training cutoff
When reading a model card, point out the license, the eval setup, and the stated limitations
For each paper card on this route, state its research question and where the core evidence sits, and name at least one popular claim the paper never makes
When reading a paper, what should you take from the abstract, setup and limitations?
Does lower perplexity mean better generation quality?
How do knowledge distillation and quantisation differ in goal?
Why does the evidence location on a paper card matter more than the conclusion?
Why distinguish open weights from open-source models, and why read the licence?
When reading a model card, how do you judge whether its evaluation is reproducible?

answers.zh: 区分基础训练、监督数据和偏好优化，记录数据来源、目标函数与评测设置；技术报告没有披露的配方应标为未知，不按常见流程补写。
answers.en: Separate base training, supervised data and preference optimization. Record data sources, objectives and evaluation setup; leave undisclosed recipe details unknown.

answers.zh: 对照题集公开时间、训练截止、基准版本与去重说明。时间重叠只能提示污染风险，不能单独证明泄题；还需看污染检查和未见任务表现。
answers.en: Compare dataset release, training cutoff, benchmark version and decontamination. Temporal overlap suggests risk, not proof of contamination; inspect checks and held-out tasks.

answers.zh: 分别记录有实验支持、设置受限与未披露的项目。例如，模型卡只报告英文结果时，不推断中文表现或生产可靠性。
answers.en: Separate experimentally supported, setup-limited and undisclosed claims. English-only model-card results do not establish Chinese performance or production reliability.

answers.zh: 示例：LIMA 研究少量高质量指令数据的作用，查看其受控人评与消融；不能据此声称少量数据能解决所有安全与鲁棒性问题。其他论文同样对应问题、证据和适用边界。
answers.en: For LIMA, inspect controlled human evaluation and ablations on small high-quality instruction datasets. This does not establish that little data solves every safety or robustness problem. Apply the same question/evidence/limits structure to other papers.

answers.zh: 摘要抓研究问题与主要主张；实验设置抓数据、基线、算力和判法；局限性抓作者承认的适用范围与未覆盖项。三处不能互相替代。
answers.en: The abstract gives the question and main claim; the setup gives data, baselines, compute and evaluation; limitations give the scope and gaps the authors admit. None substitutes for another.

answers.zh: 困惑度衡量模型对文本的预测概率，和人类偏好、事实正确性、任务完成度不是一回事。它可用于同设置下的语言建模对比，不能单独证明产品更好。
answers.en: Perplexity measures how well a model predicts text; it is not human preference, factual correctness or task success. It compares language modelling under the same setup, not product quality on its own.

answers.zh: 蒸馏让小模型学大模型的输出或表示，目标是能力迁移；量化降低权重/激活精度，目标是省显存与带宽。两者可叠加，但失败模式不同。
answers.en: Distillation trains a smaller model on a larger model’s outputs or representations to transfer capability; quantisation lowers weight/activation precision to save memory and bandwidth. They can combine, with different failure modes.

answers.zh: 结论可能被摘要简化或媒体转述；证据位置能回到具体表、图和实验设置，判断结论是否被数据支撑。没有证据位置的引用只是转述。
answers.en: Conclusions get simplified in abstracts or media; the evidence location leads back to the exact table, figure and setup, showing whether data supports the claim. A citation without a location is just retelling.

answers.zh: 开放权重只保证权重可下载，不一定允许商用、再发布或衍生；开源还涉及代码、训练数据和许可条件。许可证决定你能不能把权重放进产品。
answers.en: Open weights only means the weights can be downloaded; commercial use, redistribution or derivatives may be restricted. Open source also covers code, training data and licence terms. The licence decides whether weights can ship in a product.

answers.zh: 看它是否给出模型版本、提示与系统设置、样本集与切分、判法、判定人和日期。缺任一项，分数只能当参考，不能当可复跑的证据。
answers.en: Check whether it gives model version, prompts and system settings, sample set and split, method, judges and dates. Missing any one makes the score a reference, not reproducible evidence.

nextTask.zh: 选一篇论文完成问题、证据与局限记录
nextTask.en: Read a paper into a question/evidence/limits record
